blocks.text: This page tracks the Port Coquitlam MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for September 2026: $835,500 for a typical home, down 8.2% over twelve months.
Port Coquitlam benchmark prices and trends, September 2026

A typical Port Coquitlam home carried an MLS® Home Price Index benchmark of $835,500 in September 2026. That is little changed at −0.6% on the month, down 5.9% over three months, down 7.9% over six months and down 8.2% over the year. Over three years it is down 11.6%, and over five years little changed at +1.4%.
The weakest one-year move in Port Coquitlam was for an apartment homes at −9.0%; the strongest was a townhouse at −7.8%.
The gap between a detached home ($1,240,600) and an apartment ($550,000) is $690,600, and a townhouse ($834,300) sits $284,300 above the apartment benchmark.
Against Greater Vancouver, where the all-home benchmark was $1,075,900, Port Coquitlam is 22.3% below. Over the year Greater Vancouver moved down 5.5% against down 8.2% here.
Of the 20 areas this board reports, Port Coquitlam ranks 18 by all-home benchmark, with Pitt Meadows above it at $848,800 and Sunshine Coast below it at $805,600.

Detached homes in Port Coquitlam: benchmark $1,240,600, little changed at −0.3% in a month, down 6.2% in three months, down 8.2% in six months, down 8.5% in a year, down 11.2% in three years and up 1.5% in five. That is 30.5% below the detached benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($1,784,700).

Townhouse homes in Port Coquitlam: benchmark $834,300, down 1.5% in a month, down 4.9% in three months, down 7.6% in six months, down 7.8% in a year, down 11.1% in three years and up 2.0% in five. That is 17.9% below the townhouse benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($1,016,700).

Apartment homes in Port Coquitlam: benchmark $550,000, down 1.5% in a month, down 5.6% in three months, down 7.9% in six months, down 9.0% in a year, down 11.1% in three years and up 4.0% in five. That is 19.4% below the apartment benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($682,500).

blocks.text: What the Port Coquitlam figure is
The $835,500 Port Coquitlam figure is a modelled price for a typical home, not a median, and it comes from Greater Vancouver REALTORS® for September 2026.

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a home in Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: In September 2026, a typical Port Coquitlam home was $835,500, with detached at $1,240,600.

faq.q: Are Port Coquitlam home prices rising or falling?
faq.a: Port Coquitlam is down 8.2% over twelve months and down 5.9% over three months.
